configurations.name: api-server
runtimeArgs: cd artifacts/api-server && pnpm run build && PORT=5050 node --env-file=.env --enable-source-maps ./dist/index.mjs

configurations.name: snapcontact-expo-go
runtimeArgs: cd artifacts/snapcontact && EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://$(ipconfig getifaddr en0 || ipconfig getifaddr en1):5050/api pnpm exec expo start --lan --port 8082

configurations.name: snapcontact-web
runtimeArgs: cd artifacts/snapcontact && EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:5050/api pnpm exec expo start --web --port 8081
